prompts.shotgunPromptFP: Create an original production sprite atlas for Caelum Argenteum, an 1889 Argentine dark fantasy FPS. Transparent PNG, EXACTLY 3 equal columns and 5 equal rows, generous clear transparent gutters, no labels or text, no backgrounds or shadows. Fifteen distinct FIRST PERSON weapon view sprites. Every cell shows the SAME period side-by-side double-barrel break-action shotgun pointing away from the viewer, held with two visible brown leather gloved hands with dark steel and muted bronze wrist bracers. Walnut wood, blued steel, two parallel round barrels and exposed hammers, NO pump, NO magazine tube, NO extra barrels. Crisp detailed painted game sprite style, warm muted palette, dark outlines, coherent weapon geometry. Column 1 plain T1 steel/walnut; column2 T2 silver decorative fittings; column3 T3 silver and subtle gold fittings, same geometry and pose in all columns. Row1 hipfire ready slightly right of center, both hands firmly hold gun. Row2 centered aimed down rib between the two barrels, hands below silhouette and no scope. Row3 same gun action broken open visibly with two empty circular breeches, left hand supporting barrels, right hand at stock. Row4 action open, right hand inserting ONE brass/paper shotgun cartridge into one breech, other breech contains a cartridge. Row5 action open, right hand inserting TWO brass/paper shotgun cartridges together. Keep both hands connected to forearms cropped ONLY at the lower edge of each sprite. Each sprite isolated completely within its cell, no clipped weapon, natural first person perspective of looking down one's own hands, never side-view weapon floating separately. No muzzle flash painted into frames; runtime adds muzzle flashes. Atlas about 1536x2048, clear straight aligned grid suitable for native texture clipping. Original asset, do not copy Doom weapons.

There must be exactly two shells total in each bottom cell, both still in the hand, not a third cartridge in the gun. Preserve every other row unchanged. Keep no background, no text.

prompts.shotgunPromptWorld: Edit the reference character sprite atlas into an original shotgun-wielding Domingo atlas. EXACTLY EIGHT columns and SIX rows on fully transparent background, generous clear gutters separating every cell, no text. Preserve character identity: long dark hair and beard, steel armor with bronze edging, red scarf, blue tunic, boots. Replace EVERY carbine with a period 1889 wooden-stock side-by-side double-barrel BREAK ACTION SHOTGUN with TWO parallel barrels and exposed hammers, shorter broad paired barrels, no pump or magazine tube, held with TWO hands. Keep direction order left to right as reference: front facing viewer, front-left (face toward image left), left profile, rear-left, back, rear-right, right profile, front-right. Same eight directions EACH row. Row1 stationary low-ready with both hands on shotgun. Row2 walking left-foot-forward, gun low-ready. Row3 walking right-foot-forward. Row4 firing/aimed, shotgun shouldered, eye along rib, two hands, no painted flash. Row5 reload action broken open, two barrels tilted downward and stock retained, hands operating breech. Row6 closing break action and resuming two-handed grip. Keep coherent anatomy, exactly one character one shotgun per cell, full head and feet, common foot baseline per row, same scale throughout. Crisp detailed handpainted game sprites matching reference palette, no floor or shadow, transparency. Do not leave any single-barrel carbines or introduce third barrels.

prompts.shotgunPromptWeaponLayer: EDIT TARGET: this 3-column by 5-row shotgun first-person sprite atlas. Create its WEAPON-ONLY layer for reusable game animation. prompts.shotgunPromptHandsLayer: EDIT TARGET is the original shotgun atlas. Extract its reusable FIRST PERSON HANDS ONLY layer, keeping the EXACT canvas size, cell locations, hand size, wrist angles and poses of all 3 columns x 5 rows. Completely remove every weapon pixel: all wood stock, metal barrels, locks, hammers, breeches, sights and trigger guards must become genuinely transparent. Keep ONLY the two leather-gloved hands, fingers, dark sleeves and metal wrist bracers that were visibly in front of the weapon. Do not draw new palms or fill hidden hand parts: preserve the hand silhouette that was visible in the original so the hands will overlay an intact separate weapon layer correctly. Ready row: support hand and trigger hand at identical original coordinates, with an empty transparent gap where gun lay between them. Aimed row: both hands in original aimed grip with transparent gun channel. Third row: both hands holding invisible broken-open gun. Fourth row: left hand supporting invisible gun and right hand holding exactly ONE loose cartridge, with all weapon and seated ammunition removed. Fifth row: right hand holding exactly TWO loose cartridges, left hand supporting invisible gun, no weapon at all. Do NOT retain tiny pieces of gun or recreate gun outlines. No background, no labels. Transparent game sprite layers only. Identical framing and placement is crucial for composition.
